input.summary: Add assignment consent standard: Company free to assign to affiliates/successors; HDI needs our consent and may not assign to a competitor.
input.comment: [Playbook] Section 10.3 only confirms successors and assigns, leaving HDI free to assign this hosting arrangement to anyone, including a competitor of ours. We have added the customary consent standard: we may assign to an affiliate or to a successor in a merger or sale of substantially all assets without consent, while HDI needs our consent (not unreasonably withheld) and may not assign to our competitors. We can accept a mutual notice-and-consent formulation as a fallback.

ops.oldText: but no other person shall acquire or have any rights under this Agreement.
ops.newText: but no other person shall acquire or have any rights under this Agreement. The Company may assign this Agreement, in whole or in part, without HDI's consent, to an affiliate or to a successor in interest by way of merger, acquisition or sale of all or substantially all of its assets. HDI may not assign this Agreement, in whole or in part, without the prior written consent of the Company, which consent shall not be unreasonably withheld, and in no event may HDI assign this Agreement to a competitor of the Company. Any change of control of the Company shall not constitute an assignment or give HDI any right to terminate, suspend or re-price this Agreement.
